I will plant my beans mixed with other crops on this small plot using the seed I can manage to get, and I do not plan to put chemical fertilizer here because fertilizer is costly and I usually save it for maize if I have any. I can put some manure or compost if I have enough at home, and I will rely mostly on family work for planting, weeding, and harvesting. I do not expect to irrigate, and I am not likely to use pesticide because we rarely use it on food crops unless the problem is very serious.
